reason: The reviews, UL number and free returns are reassuring, but a white paper cloud pendant is a look I can probably find on Amazon for a lot less. I'd pin it to my dining room board and keep comparing.
objection: Sixty reviews is a small track record, and I can't tell why this one is worth $249 when lookalike paper pendants are everywhere for a third of that.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that it is clearly better made than the Amazon lookalikes (side-by-side photos, materials, how the paper and LED hold up after a year), or a price nearer $180.
